subject: Factor Analysis with both binary and count data

messages.author: 3c29284a4916116b
messages.subject: Factor Analysis with both binary and count data
parts:
In lavaan, is there a way to do factor analysis, specifying that the items are on different scales: both binary data and count data (with the count data itself on different metrics, since some items had a higher total possible count)?

I'll greatly appreciate any advice, thank you!
